bundles.notes: Baseline bundle baked into APK 0.1.1-test (versionCode 2). Current live snapshot: Fix Round 1 engine, original music, new title art, mazed routes, 509 re-sliced walk sheets, fixed tile 61.
Identical to 2026.11.01-1 (current snapshot) plus a visible 'OTA v2' title-screen marker.

Fix Round 2: gym 4-8 + Champion page-condition fix (game completable again), Route 2 battleback restored, full Mart/Dept Store stocks, gyms 4-8 award badges, evolution stones respect type, Mach Bike refuses indoors, Dex totals /504, daycare compatibility + walking egg. Marker 'OTA v3'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass A: unified stat model for player + wilds + trainers (one formula from species base stats), base stats normalized by evolution stage (36 species), all damage formulas rescaled (avg turns-to-KO ~3.6 at Lv50), EXP rebalance (fewer wins per level), Stadium Lv50 band recalibrated to 620. Verified live: stats probe 87/87, wild battle + gym multi-turn, capture/save-load smoke, FULL 5-round Stadium clear (engine wins=1). Marker 'OTA v4'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass B: battle UI rebuilt to the Champions plate standard - status plates are static (foe top-right, ally left) and can never overlap a battler (art measured per bitmap and fit-capped; tallest roster art verified live), EXP row fully inside the ally plate, plates and battlers stay above MZ's opaque battle-window band at all times; HP shows as bar + PERCENTAGE on both sides, raw HP numbers removed everywhere in battle (incl. switch window); long species names shrink-to-fit instead of sliding under the type badge. Battle FX: type-colored impact bursts (bigger on KO), foe shake + red-flash hit reaction, player-side damage popups (stock MZ never renders them in front view), sink-and-fade player KO. Overworld camera zoom 1.5x with corrected touch mapping (perf-neutral on the rig: FPS ratio 0.93-1.00). Stadium party restore now returns members at true full HP (was 90%). js/ota.js restored to the bundle (missing from v3/v4 bundles). Verified: rig2 ship gate PASS 27/27, p2b live suite 18/18, unit suites FR1 10/10, FR2 11/11, P2A 5/5, P2B 13/13. Marker 'OTA v5'.
